text:
debrief db-021
1) the case file e-x-h-i-b-i-t 021 r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e-s an i-n-i-t-i-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w of p-e-r-m-i-t a-p-p-l-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-t-u-s and n-o t-a-t-i-o-n of a m-u-n-i-c-i-p-a-l i-t-y j-u-r-i-s-d-i-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k that w-a-s n-e-v-e-r r-u-n.
2) the record s-h-o-w-s t-h-a-t w-e-b l-i-s-t-i-n-g s-c-r-e-e-n-shots w-e-r-e c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d into a s-i-n-g-l-e f-o-l-d-e-r for t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y and l-e-f-t an i-n-c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-a-b l-e while m-i-s-s-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of o-n-l-i-n-e p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e c-l-a-i-m-s.
3) the log n-o-t-e-s a d-e-t-a-i-l-e-d e-x-a-m-i-n-a-t-i-o-n of p-l-a-n-t s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g m-e-t-h-o-d-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d-s and f-o-u-n-d a m-i-s-m-a-t-c-h in d-a-t-i-n-g that w-a-s n-e-v-e r e-s-c-a-l-a-t-e-d for f-u-r-t-h-e-r i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o-n.
4) the archive i-n-d-i-c-a-t-e-s a f-o-l-l-o-w-u-p with w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e o-f-f-i-c-e-r-s r-e-g-a-r-d-i-n-g b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g f-a-c-i-l-i-t-y i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s and l-o-g-g-e-d a b-r-i-e-f s-u-m-m-a-r-y while o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g the r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d s-a-m-p-l-e c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
5) the final e-n-t-r-y d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-s a n-e-x-t-s-t-e-p p-l-a-n to a-g-g-r-e-g-a-t-e a-d-d-i-t-i-o-n-a-l e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e f-r-o-m t-h-e p-u-b-l-i-c r-e-c-o-r-d-s and s-e-t an o-p-e-n i-t-e-m for i-m-p-a-c-t a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t that r-e-m-a-i-n-e-d u-n-r-e-s-o-l-v-e-d at c-l-o-s-u-r-e.
